reviews.title: Accessibility implementation host boundary
reviews.summary: The HTML5 adapter consumes child-zero name/value callbacks for placement semantics. The shared host family verifies that custom child trees, roles, states and actions remain unconnected; the existing Partial classification is retained with a precise limitation.

entries.note: The HTML5 host uses get_accName(0) and get_accValue(0) for a placement's label and description. Child-ID trees and custom role, state, selection and default-action behavior are not bridged.
